claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Toyota and Lexus parts
claims.evidence: This is a general business claim that cannot be confirmed from a photo of a single part.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's sticker or embossed part number on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic aftermarket unit for an older, low-value model

risks.proof: A video showing the unit connected to a power source with all light functions (DRL, high/low beam) illuminated.

risks.risk: Broken mounting tabs or cracked rear housing
risks.proof: Photos of the back and sides of the unit showing all plastic mounting brackets intact.

proof_requests: Photo of the part number sticker or manufacturer markings on the housing.
Photos of the back of the unit to inspect the mounting tabs and connectors.
Video of the headlight powered on and functioning.
response.reason: The specific vehicle model this part fits is not identified in the photos or text, and headlight values vary by hundreds of thousands of Naira depending on the car model and year. A part number is essential for an accurate valuation.
